'''Meserian''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], it was used as a hiding place by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis]] and his group shortly after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bardan Jusik]] and former [[Clone commando/Legends|Republic commando]] [[Fi Skirata]] went there and met with Altis to discuss their intent of transferring refugee Jedi into Altis's group.<ref name="IC 501st" />
